title: Great App, needs improvement with syncing Exchange Calendars
body:
The Calendar App is great, it makes keeping track of your schedule much simpler.

I like how I can colour code my different calendars, so I see all my work and personal items in one place.

I like that I can view shared calendars, so I see when my colleagues life 

I don’t like that sometimes the Calendar App doesn’t show meetings that I have been invited to, even though the meeting invite appears in my email inbox. This happens often with some recurring meetings in my exchange calendar. The meeting would just not appear in the calendar, so I need to keep track of the meetings using my Microsoft Teams Calendar. Sometimes I would also create my own replica of the meeting in my calendar, however, this isn’t effective when the meeting details change, e.g. date, time, location, subject, attachments, etc.

Overall, I would recommend this app to anyone using an iOS device.
